title: Programming Manager: Launch clearance
notice: Demo with sample data only. It is not connected to your organization's data, and it should not be.
question: Can we put Silver Harbor on our streaming service in the UK, and which contract clause says so?

answer.question: Can we put Silver Harbor on our streaming service in the UK, and which contract clause says so?
answer.answer:
**Yes, but not yet.** Silver Harbor is cleared for the UK on your owned streaming service, starting when the theatrical holdback ends in **24 days**. Launching before then is blocked.

**Contract clause:** Clause 3.1 of the UK Rights Agreement (SH-UK-2026, status: Approved):
> "Exclusive UK subscription streaming rights are granted for 24 months from the end of the theatrical holdback."

No launch date has been set yet. I can check whether the request is ready for rights-team approval, or confirm the full distribution window.
